comparison: TCN minus each comparator daily mean IC and count of positive days. Descriptive uncertainty around daily mean difference via circular moving blocks of five observations, 10,000 replications, RNG 20261127. 67 dates include gaps and have already been inspected, not a fresh forward test. Assessment chiefly on Rank IC; no pretense of portfolio performance.
evidence: Ablation for architectural added value. A single training seed and a previously examined 2025H1 validation panel. No selection or fitting on these outcomes. No 2025H2.
training: 5,000 identical ordered training batches, 2023-2024, seed 20261126, PyTorch AdamW lr .001 wd .0001 and Huber delta 1 on train-only minute-scaled log return. Inputs from identical 30 bars with six prices/volume fields and two known clocks. Fit flat linear 240->1 and flat MLP 240->24->1 with LeakyReLU. Same normalization tables as existing Gate16.
primary_metric: Cross-sectional Spearman for same valid rows each minute, average ties. Common nonconstant minutes, minimum 20; equal minute within day then equal day.
secondary_metric: Within-stock Spearman across same valid timestamps, minimum 20 nonconstant, equal stock within day and equal day. Pooled sample-weighted Huber(delta=1) using train minute scale for log-return predictions only; include constant zero loss. Reversal score is for ranking only.
selection_check: Complementary equal-capacity selection: each minute take top floor(1% of all candidates) per score with code tie-break ascending; keys selected before lookahead, independent 5-minute per-name lock within each arm; reentry at t+5. No TCN prediction threshold or future filter. Compare realized pooled and day-weighted mean simple gross return from next open to fifth close; hypothetical 10 bp round-trip scenario. These signal averages are not capital-weighted portfolio returns.
validation_huber: Official cross-run validation Huber uses the fixed common train-wide return_scale 0.0030267951862079545. Report this separately from the training-objective minute-scale Huber for all predictive arms and zero. The cross-sectional Rank IC comparison is unchanged.
